prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one standalone editorial art illustration for 威海锡镶制作工艺, Weihai tin-inlay craft; not a website screenshot or replacement city hero.

Create an original contemporary silver-line and clay-relief composition: a small complete invented tea vessel with a warm plum-brown matte body, a clearly readable lid, spout and handle, and a restrained sinuous tin-alloy-like silver ornament following the vessel's curved surface. The clay base must remain dominant; do not render the whole teapot as polished silver or pure tin. Sparse decorative lines have shallow raised edges and soft oblique glints, not dense jewellery filigree or a factual joining mechanism.

Art language: tactile low-relief illustration with brushed silver-foil-like marks, chalky clay grain and a pale mineral/stone-blue plane. Use one small muted ochre geometric surface beneath part of the vessel, softly angled shadows and clean graphic spacing. A slightly elevated oblique still life, crisp and material-led, clearly different from watery ink. Contemporary imagined material art, not a real product photograph, museum object, named maker's work, accurate historical pattern or verified alloy sample. Not dark-stone amber theatre lighting, shell nacre, straw marquetry or a scenic panorama.

ONE complete horizontal3:2 artwork, ideally native1536×1024. Keep the entire vessel and its small visual support inside the central44% of width and60% of height, with generous light blue margins and no essential motif cut by the canvas. Compact focused subject should suit an uncropped desktop illustration and a mobile4:5 detail view. No collage board, frame, mockup, border or multiple panels.

No tools, hands, production process, exploded diagram, labels, food-safety claim, chemical formula, brands or copies of specific works. No writing at all: no letters, Chinese characters, calligraphy, signature, seals, museum numbers, watermark, logos, pseudo-writing or UI.
